energy: Oil and gas producers cut crude output as OPEC reviews its quota. Refineries face tighter fuel supplies.
Solar farms, photovoltaic panels and wind turbines deliver renewable power to the electricity grid.
A utility needs new transmission lines and battery storage to meet electric power demand.
Nuclear power plants and reactors produce electricity as coal plants retire.
Natural gas pipelines and LNG exports change the price of heating fuel.
Drought cuts hydroelectric generation while utilities restart fossil fuel plants.
Offshore drilling, shale wells and petroleum reserves expand oil production.
tech: Software developers patch a Java vulnerability after a cyberattack exposes customer accounts.
Apple restores iCloud, Apple Pay and other online services after a digital outage.
Artificial intelligence labs train a language model. AI chips and data centers compete for computing capacity.
Nvidia designs processors and semiconductors for computers. Chipmakers build advanced chips.
Cloud computing networks, DNS servers and internet platforms recover from a security breach.
A startup releases a smartphone app and a developer toolkit for mobile devices.
Social media platforms and search engines change how their algorithms rank posts.
healthcare: A measles outbreak leads to vaccination clinics as public health officials track infections.
Hospitals and nurses care for patients with heart disease, diabetes and cancer.
A drugmaker reports clinical trial results and seeks FDA approval for a new treatment.
Medicare and Medicaid insurance coverage affects hospital bills and access to medical care.
Scientists study viruses, disease transmission, immunization and vaccine effectiveness.
A medical device detects early symptoms and helps doctors diagnose patients.
Mental health researchers evaluate a therapy for depression in a clinical study.
Neuroscience researchers study brain activity and neural implants in clinical research with patients.
industrials: Aircraft manufacturers and aerospace suppliers deliver engines and airplanes to airlines.
Automakers retool assembly lines while factories expand industrial production and manufacturing.
Railroads, trucking companies and ports report freight delays and shipping container shortages.
Machinery makers install industrial robots and machine tools in steel mills.
Construction contractors order heavy equipment to build bridges and railway infrastructure.
Logistics firms move cargo through warehouses as a dockworkers strike disrupts supply chains.
A shipbuilder opens a shipyard to make vessels and transport equipment.
consumer-discretionary: Retailers report comparable store sales, apparel demand and department store spending.
Auto dealers say discretionary spending on cars and electric vehicles increased.
Hotel bookings, cruise line reservations and leisure travel demand lift tourism revenue.
Restaurants and fast food chains report same store sales and menu pricing.
Consumer brands and e-commerce merchants prepare for holiday shopping.
materials: Mining companies develop copper, gold and iron ore mines and expand mineral reserves.
Steelmakers and aluminum smelters report lower output of primary metals.
Specialty chemicals producers and fertilizer manufacturers raise feedstock prices.
Paper mills and packaging suppliers increase paperboard and pulp production.
Cement and aggregates producers sell construction materials to contractors.
utilities: Utility regulators approve electric utility rates and ratepayer bill increases.
Grid operators upgrade transmission lines and electricity distribution substations.
Water utilities invest in wastewater treatment plants and drinking water systems.
A public utility commission reviews cost recovery and the utility rate base.
Electric utilities restore power after outages and replace distribution poles.
real-estate: Home sales, housing starts and mortgage rates shape the residential housing market.
Commercial real estate investors buy office buildings as lease vacancy rates rise.
A real estate investment trust reports occupancy and rents for multifamily apartments.
Property developers seek planning permission for industrial real estate and warehouses.
Homebuilders report house prices and residential construction permits.
general: Voters decide a national election. Congress debates party leadership, policy and campaign spending.
Diplomats discuss peace negotiations as a military conflict continues overseas.
Actors and directors attend a film festival while an author releases a new novel.
A football team wins its championship and fans celebrate a playoff victory.
A court hears arguments on immigration law as the government announces a border policy.
A chef opens a restaurant and shares a recipe. Travelers visit museums and parks.
Schools and universities debate curriculum and the cost of a college education.
World leaders discuss trade, tariffs and diplomatic relations at an international summit. Export negotiations affect the talks.
The Senate weighs military appointments and the defense secretary discusses army leadership and foreign policy.
Weather forecasters track a storm as schools close and families prepare to evacuate.
